# Elect Righteous

> A source-cited voter guide for Hays, Kansas and the 2026 Kansas elections.

Elect Righteous profiles every candidate across federal, state, and local Kansas races on the
2026 ballot (and the current officeholders in races not yet up for election), with equal
research depth for every candidate regardless of incumbency or party. No grading, scoring, or
partisan labels — every claim on the site traces back to a cited, dated public source so a
voter can read the primary record directly.

## Pages

- [Home](https://electrighteous.com/): Overview of all 2026 Kansas elections and candidates.
- [About](https://electrighteous.com/about/): How candidates are researched and sourced.
- [Candidates](https://electrighteous.com/candidates/): Every candidate profile, filterable by party and status.
- [Elections](https://electrighteous.com/elections/): Every federal, state, local, and ballot-measure race.

## Notes

- Every candidate page links to a dedicated sources page listing every citation used.
- Content is nonpartisan: candidates are held to identical scrutiny and the same evidence
  standard regardless of party or incumbency.
